application.source: Privately supplied original project. Product code, art, screenshots and credentials are excluded from this record.
actions: Tap its text field and enter an eight-character synthetic marker through the Android EditText.
Confirm, tap the original login button and observe the original server selection view.
Force-stop the isolated package and reopen. Verify the saved marker in the original input.

separateRelease.build: Offline Release APK and AAB using a separate application ID and local self-signed test identity. The release has no QA state publisher or embedded color fixture.
separateRelease.signatures: APK Signature Scheme v2 and signed bundle JAR were verified. The key is a local test key.
separateRelease.test: The APK was installed on the same Fold7. Its original login field opened with an empty native EditText. USB input entered the marker. The original button opened server selection. After force-stop and reopening, the native EditText contained the same marker.
